name: [QRPS] SG-12 'Torrent' Assault Shotgun
teaser: Full-Auto 12g AR-10? Check. Nutty experimental ammo? Check. Awesome mod from FancyDream updated from AKI 2.0 to 3.10? You better believe it.
description_html:
An absolutely awesome AR-10-based assault shotgun from FancyDream, updated to 3.10! Featuring compatibility with AR-based weapon parts, as well as 3 custom experiment 12g rounds which are all kinda nuts, this weapon will well and truly make your factory raids just that little bit more scary. The rounds work in all 12 gauge shotguns, and the muzzle can be put on anything that takes a 12g muzzle, so feel free to run a double-barrel with electromagnetic gauss rounds.

FAQ:

Where buy? Mechanic LL3 for the gun, Mechanic LL4 for the experimental rounds.

Realism? Yes

Where original? Oddba

What QRPS? Qwerty-Reaper Porting Service (Turns out there’s a bunch of old bundles on Oddba that never got updated, and we decided to port some of them to give them one last hurrah before the Unity update bricks the bundles, also I like acronyms.)

Credits to the original author FancyDream! We wouldn’t have this now if you didn’t originally make these awesome bundles!
